score: 100 * mean over fixed tolerances of fraction of Euclidean errors strictly below tolerance; equal scenes, conditions, candidates and horizons within scene
threshold_origin: TAP-Vid discrete tolerances 1,2,4,8,16 at256px, mapped by canvas width. Exploratory accuracy scale, not certified task-specific tolerances. Fixed without inspecting candidate model scores. Block coordinate+angle distance remains auxiliary.
geometry: Canonical physical_targets_from_panel output; PushT block angle is already40sin/cos, no repeat scaling; no hidden velocities scored.
calibration_screen: Necessary measurement screen only: >=95% of held-out true-future readouts within the strictest tolerance; not a capability gate and not proof of readout validity on predicted latents.
statistics: Scene macro average; source cluster bootstrap1000 with seed20261008; paired changes share source scenes and source IDs.
failure_policy: Keep failures, low scores and negative context gains; never discard difficult rows or tune tolerances to model results.
publication: Keep existing9task benchmark scores; report candidate score and calibration separately. Do not call readout score true physical accuracy or report one official crossmodel leaderboard until measurement validation passes.
